create_convnext_model: create a ConvNeXt trunk model from VISSL config with specified depths, dims, and drop path rate
build_convnext_block: build a ConvNeXt Block with depthwise conv, pointwise convs, layer norm, and stochastic depth
build_layer_norm: build a LayerNorm module supporting both channels_last and channels_first data formats
run_convnext_forward: run a ConvNeXt forward pass that extracts features and returns global average pooled embeddings
test_convnext_init_weights: test the ConvNeXt _init_weights method that initializes conv and linear layers with trunc normal
